dedupe_keys.name: geoportal lt lithuanian national spatial information portal

description: Geoportal.lt (Lithuanian national spatial information portal) is a portal or repository of infrastructure or hazard data run by Construction Sector Development Agency of Lithuania. The portal offers a map browser and data search over state land plots, cadastral and administrative boundaries, orthophotos and historical aerial imagery, forest and habitat data, bathymetry of inland waters, electricity distribution network layers and a land reclamation and inundation database, published through MapServer, ArcGIS REST and WMS endpoints. Coverage: Lithuania. Formats and interfaces named: WMS, API. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: not stated on the page. Caveats: the page gives no licence terms or update dates, and most layers concern land and environment, not infrastructure; the network layers of the distribution operator are catalogued separately. It can support locating networks, land reclamation systems and inundation areas in Lithuania. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: page text read; the data themselves were not downloaded.
